Pages 43 and 45 carry the first ~19 issues (43 for FY2021-FY2036, 45 for FY2037-FY2047 and the TOTAL column); pages 44 and 46 carry the LAST THREE issues over the same two year ranges, and the GRAND TOTAL block. READ, NOT RECOGNISED: pdfplumber returns 1 word on each page, so there is no text layer; each page is a single JPEG2000 bitmap (~1060x1400 px, ~125 dpi) printed LANDSCAPE on a portrait sheet, rotated upright and read at 2.2x in two overlapping halves per page so that the label column appears beside every year. PAGE 46 WAS NOT IN THE PAGE TRACKER. It carries the GRAND TOTAL block for FY2037-FY2047 and the whole schedule's TOTAL column -- $45,109,859 principal, $17,582,455 interest, $62,692,314 principal and interest, $20,526 MWPAT admin fees, $62,712,839 total debt -- so the schedule cannot be proved without it. It is the same pattern the process document names: a page enters the tracker on fifteen money figures, and the page carrying a table's TOTALS is the one most likely to be invisible. THE SCHEDULE PRINTS DISPLAYED WHOLE DOLLARS OVER AMOUNTS THAT CARRY CENTS, so a printed total is the ROUNDED SUM and not the sum of the rounded parts. A tolerance is DECLARED for that and the reason is this: the three per-issue PRINCIPAL columns, which are whole dollars in the bond schedules and carry no cents under them, tie EXACTLY at $1,460,000 / $980,000 / $1,695,000, while every column with cents under it misses by $3, $7 and $3. That contrast is the evidence. Twenty-seven displayed values can differ from their own rounded sum by up to $13.50 in the worst case; the largest difference anywhere here is $7, and on the grand-total block it is $2. The tolerance was NOT widened to make anything pass -- the per-year row identities principal + interest = total close EXACTLY on all 81 issue rows, and it is only the 27-term column sums and the two-term grand-total identities (which are themselves sums of rounded figures) that carry it. THIS FILE IS THE GRAND TOTAL BLOCK -- the Town's whole forward debt service, FY2021 to FY2047, one row per year, which is the series anybody would chart. Five columns as the page heads them: GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL, GRAND TOTAL INTEREST, GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL & INTEREST, GRAND TOTAL MWPAT ADMIN FEES, TOTAL DEBT. All five add down to the TOTAL column printed on page 46 within the declared $2 tolerance, and each year states principal + interest = principal and interest and principal and interest + MWPAT admin fees = total debt. MWPAT is the Mass Water Pollution Abatement Trust; the page's own footnote says those payment amounts are to be subsidised by equity earnings and contract assistance payments, so the TOTAL DEBT line is not what the town raises for them.
